* {{ill|Shisho Shrine (Tsugaru)|ja|四所神社 (つがる市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shisho Shrine (Tsugaru)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in {{ill|Tsugaru, Aomori|en|Tsugaru, Aomori|qid=Q372517|lt=Tsugaru|1=Tsugaru, Aomori}}, {{ill|Aomori Prefecture|en|Aomori Prefecture|qid=Q71699|lt=Aomori Prefecture|1=Aomori Prefecture}}.
